title: Nighttime Shock Release: DeepSeek V4 Pro Official Version Makes Its Debut, Standing Shoulder to Shoulder with Top Fable Models

content_html:
On August 13th, the AI field experienced a surge of product launches. While Musk launched Grok4.6 and Qwen3.8Max, an open-source model from Tongyi, DeepSeek also quietly released the official version of V4Pro - DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 at midnight.

The official version is now fully available, with both its API and Chat interface updated. Users can access the latest version by simply specifying the relevant name without changing their existing methods.

Official performance benchmark tests show that V4-Pro-0813 performs exceptionally well in all core metrics, not only surpassing Opus4.8 but also demonstrating strong competitiveness compared to the top-tier American Fable5 model, placing it in the first tier of the industry overall.

In terms of pricing, this version continues to be three times the price of V4-Flash. Although the official had previously mentioned a pricing adjustment plan, the specific adjustment has not yet been displayed on the platform page, and it is expected that related price change notifications will be officially released through official channels later.

content_html_zh:
8月13日，AI领域迎来了产品发布热潮。 在马斯克推出Grok4.6和同益开源模型Qwen3.8Max的同时，DeepSeek也在午夜悄然发布了V4Pro的正式版本——DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813。

正式版现已全面上线，API和聊天界面均已更新。 用户只需指定相关名称即可访问最新版本，无需更改现有方法。

官方性能基准测试显示，V4-Pro-0813各项核心指标均表现异常出色，不仅超越Opus4.8，而且与美国顶级Fable5机型相比也展现出了强大的竞争力，整体处于行业第一梯队。

定价方面，该版本继续是V4-Flash价格的三倍。 虽然官方此前曾提及定价调整计划，但具体调整内容尚未在平台页面显示，预计稍后将通过官方渠道正式发布相关价格变动通知。
